name: Tidal Dockline Waterproof Work Pant
description: Full waterproof construction with sealed seams and a rubberized outer shell over an insulating liner. Cut wide through the thigh for full movement when hauling lines or working wet cargo platforms. Standard in navy or dark teal; most pairs end up salt-stained and faded along the lower legs.
functionality: Waterproof sealed seams, thermal liner, wide-cut freedom-of-movement build
what_it_says: You work on or near water, you've been doing it a while, and you'd rather be warm than look good.
story_hooks: Tidal pants are sold in bulk to port labor contractors — finding a pair with a contractor's stencil code on the back waistband can identify which company employed the wearer.
The wide-leg cut makes them popular with Tier 1 residents who need to conceal items below the knee without obvious bulk.
